start: Warm start from the DEV-selected A1 large ranker; verified E00 retained as safe fallback
scope: A1 UA features only: unigram segmentation, contextual/case features and scoped agreement; existing feature function unchanged
feature_vocabulary: TRAIN-only existing A1 large cache; minimum two examples per feature
objective: Mean partial-label conditional NLL + squared residual norm / TRAIN example count; same total objective as prior A1 divided by TRAIN count
epoch: One seeded shuffled pass over all 55129 competitive labelled TRAIN examples, each exactly once
untrainable_words: Candidate-missing, unresolved projection and noncompetitive words do not receive invented training labels; all DEV words stay in the evaluation denominator
checkpoint_selection: Full-decoder DEV lemma+POS correct count, strict increase over safe E00/best; retain E00 if no safe improvement
safety: Finite weights/losses, unchanged candidates and reconstruction, valid relation graph and verified decoder objective; DEV declared-feature count must not fall and wrong committed lemma decisions must not rise versus E00
diagnostic_losses: Mean data NLL on complete fixed eligible TRAIN and DEV examples; regularizer excluded from diagnostic loss
controls: training_controls/e70p9/protocol.json: E70, P9, E21 overfit monitoring, 3 consecutive signals
backup: Two SHA-256 verified copies on V, latest two epochs plus safe best; E00 is independently retained
github: Per-epoch aggregate metrics/log outbox and local commit; connected GitHub app may publish while CLI authentication is unavailable
TEST_and_CALIB: Neither opened nor used in this A1 run. Previously observed TEST is not treated as unseen
A3_A2: Not launched by this A1 trainer
